summary: Build and evaluate retrieval, ranking, and recommendation experiments with TensorFlow Recommenders. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: Recommendation systems training covers building and evaluating personalized product and media recommendations from interaction data. For data scientists, machine-learning engineers, and personalization product practitioners, it develops skills in checking interaction data, defining user and item features, training retrieval and ranking models, interpreting offline metrics, planning A/B tests, and monitoring releases.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you build, evaluate, deploy, or improve personalized recommendations across product catalogues or media libraries.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of machine learning concepts, interaction data, and model evaluation is expected. Coding in Python is required for the hands-on TensorFlow Recommenders work; prior experience building recommendation models is useful but not required.
